questions.text: Two hosts are connected via a packet switch with [latex]10^{7}[/latex] bits per second links. Each link has a propagation delay of 20 microseconds. The switch begins forwarding a packet 35 microseconds after it receives the same. If 10000 bits of data are to be transmitted between the two hosts using a packet size of 5000 bits, the time elapsed between the transmission of the first bit of data and the reception of the last bit of the data in microseconds is____________.
questions.solution:
Each packet: [latex]T_t=\frac{5000}{10^7}=500\,\mu s[/latex], propagation 20 [latex]\mu s[/latex], switch delay 35 [latex]\mu s[/latex].

- Packet 1: sent 0-500, at switch by 520, forwarded 555-1055, received by 1075
- Packet 2: sent 500-1000, at switch by 1020, forwarded 1055-1555, received by 1575

Answer: 1575

questions.text: Consider a network connecting two systems located 8000 kilometers apart. The bandwidth of the network is 500x[latex]10^{6}[/latex] bits per second. The propagation speed of the media is 4x[latex]10^{6}[/latex] meters per second. It is needed to design a Go-Back-N sliding window protocol for this network. The average packet size is [latex]10^{7}[/latex] bits. The network is to be used to its full capacity. Assume that processing delays at nodes are negligible. Then, the minimum size in bits of the sequence number field has to be ___________.
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- [latex]T_p=\frac{8\times10^6}{4\times10^6}=2[/latex] s
- [latex]T_t=\frac{10^7}{5\times10^8}=0.02[/latex] s

Window for full use = [latex]1+\frac{2T_p}{T_t}=1+200=201[/latex]. Go-Back-N needs at least W + 1 = 202 sequence numbers.

[latex]2^8=256\ge202[/latex] [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 8 bits

Answer: 8

questions.text: In the network 200.10.11.144/27, the fourth octet (in decimal) of the last IP address of the network which can be assigned to a host is ____________.
questions.solution:
/27 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] blocks of 32 addresses. 144 lies in the block 128 to 159.

159 is the broadcast address, so the last usable host is 158.

Answer: 158
